tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background in the app, and the ground of every share card in its theme. The Mist sky fades into it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised controls on bg: icon buttons, text fields, the segmented track, banners, skeletons, pitch tokens, the share sheet, emoji tiles on cards.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Controls on surface: share-sheet option tiles and its Cancel button, rules inside the sheet.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: The flat rank pill (no movement) and other neutral fills that sit on bg.

tokens.name: segment-selected
tokens.usage: The selected segment inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px row separators, the tab bar's top edge, outlines of scaled card previews.

tokens.name: card-rule
tokens.usage: Frames, rules and rank-chart guides inside share cards.

tokens.name: watched
tokens.usage: Story ring once a story is watched; the share sheet's grabber.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-2, surface-3 and pitch (12:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: team names, labels, captions, unselected tabs. On bg and surface (5.2:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Dashed baselines and other decoration. As text only on cards at 24px or larger (the watermark, 4.3:1). Never text in the light theme.

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: Moving up: rank pill fill, sparklines and trend lines above the league average, up arrows in tables. Always paired with a ▲ or a position, never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-up
tokens.usage: Text on an up fill (9.6:1 dark, 4.9:1 light).

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Moving down: rank pill fill, lines below the average, down arrows, error text and the error field border (4.7:1 or more on bg and surface).

tokens.name: on-down
tokens.usage: Text on a down fill (6.4:1 dark, 5.2:1 light).

tokens.name: pitch
tokens.usage: Team of the Week pitch ground (Matchday grass, chosen by Ralph 2026-10-13). The same in both themes, like a card. Muted on purpose: far from the Premier League's neon green.

tokens.name: pitch-stripe
tokens.usage: Every other mowing stripe on the pitch.

tokens.name: pitch-line
tokens.usage: Chalk markings: touchlines, halfway line, centre circle and spot, both boxes, penalty spots and arcs, corner arcs. Decoration only.

tokens.name: on-pitch
tokens.usage: Player names on the pitch (6.0:1 on pitch-stripe, 6.9:1 on pitch).

tokens.name: pitch-chip
tokens.usage: A player's points pill on the pitch.

tokens.name: on-pitch-chip
tokens.usage: Points on pitch-chip (19:1).

tokens.name: pitch-top
tokens.usage: The week's top player's points pill: the dark accent, in both themes (the pitch doesn't change with the theme).

tokens.name: on-pitch-top
tokens.usage: Points on pitch-top (13.3:1).

tokens.name: pitch-badge
tokens.usage: How many in the league own a player: the small badge on the shirt's shoulder.

tokens.name: on-pitch-badge
tokens.usage: The count on pitch-badge (19:1).

tokens.name: tabbar-bg
tokens.usage: Tab bar background, so content scrolls faintly beneath it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the story behind the share sheet.

tokens.name: story-bg
tokens.usage: Story viewer ground. The viewer is dark in both themes.

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: Unplayed part of a story progress segment; the played part is ink (dark).

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Deep teal, the top of the Mist sky. Text on it is white only (11.9:1). Also the light theme's accent.

tokens.name: brand-pale
tokens.usage: Pale mint, the lower middle of the light sky. Ink text 16:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one thing to press or notice: primary buttons, the Wrapped story face, the top player's points, banner marks, the "You" tag. Low chroma on purpose: the Premier League palette is neon.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent (13.3:1 dark, 11.9:1 light).

tokens.name: ring-start
tokens.usage: Top of an unwatched story ring (3:1 or more against the sky behind it).

tokens.name: ring-end
tokens.usage: Bottom of an unwatched story ring.

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: Titles and controls on the deep-teal top of the sky, in both themes.

tokens.name: on-sky-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the deep-teal top of the sky (the GW picker, a subtitle). Only above where the sky turns mint.

tokens.name: on-sky-fill
tokens.usage: Icon buttons and pills on the deep-teal top of the sky.

tokens.name: you-tint
tokens.usage: The row of the person using the app, in Market and Table.

tokens.name: frame-top
tokens.usage: Top of a card frame's fill (the panel holding a card's chart).

tokens.name: frame-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of a card frame's fill.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Doubtful status chips. Text on it is on-caution (10:1).

tokens.name: on-caution
tokens.usage: Text on caution.

tokens.name: diff-1
tokens.usage: Very easy fixture (FPL difficulty 1) in the ticker. Always printed with its number.

tokens.name: on-diff-1
tokens.usage: Text on diff-1 (4.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: diff-2
tokens.usage: Easy fixture (FPL difficulty 2) in the ticker. Always printed with its number.

tokens.name: on-diff-2
tokens.usage: Text on diff-2 (4.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: diff-3
tokens.usage: Average fixture (FPL difficulty 3) in the ticker. Always printed with its number.

tokens.name: on-diff-3
tokens.usage: Text on diff-3 (4.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: diff-4
tokens.usage: Hard fixture (FPL difficulty 4) in the ticker. Always printed with its number.

tokens.name: on-diff-4
tokens.usage: Text on diff-4 (4.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: diff-5
tokens.usage: Very hard fixture (FPL difficulty 5) in the ticker. Always printed with its number.

tokens.name: on-diff-5
tokens.usage: Text on diff-5 (4.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: badge-1
tokens.usage: Team badge fill (ochre). on-badge text 6.4:1.

tokens.name: badge-2
tokens.usage: Team badge fill (rust). on-badge text 6.3:1.

tokens.name: badge-3
tokens.usage: Team badge fill (pine). on-badge text 6.0:1.

tokens.name: badge-4
tokens.usage: Team badge fill (cobalt). on-badge text 7.4:1.

tokens.name: badge-5
tokens.usage: Team badge fill (wine). on-badge text 7.5:1.

tokens.name: badge-6
tokens.usage: Team badge fill (ocean). on-badge text 5.7:1.

tokens.name: badge-7
tokens.usage: Team badge fill (olive). on-badge text 6.1:1.

tokens.name: badge-8
tokens.usage: Team badge fill (stone). on-badge text 7.7:1.

tokens.name: on-badge
tokens.usage: Initials on every badge fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset onto bg. 16:1 or more in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Start screen headline only.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: League name at the top of Market and League.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Manager names in rows, button labels, sheet options.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Field values and running text. Never smaller than 17px.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: GW picker, field labels, segments, quiet buttons, banners (at 400).

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Team names under manager names, column notes.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Story labels, player names on the pitch, rank pills (at 700).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Tab labels and owner-count badges. The smallest size allowed.

styles.name: card-hero
styles.usage: The one number a card is about. Proportional figures.

styles.name: wrap-average
styles.usage: League average in the Wrap's gradient panel.

styles.name: card-name
styles.usage: Winner's first name (64px when two or three share the award).

styles.name: card-roast
styles.usage: The roast line, anchored above the watermark.

styles.name: card-label
styles.usage: Award title beside its emoji; also the hero's one line of context in ink-2.

styles.name: card-meta
styles.usage: League name and GW, uppercase, ink-2; the watermark in ink-3.

styles.name: card-x-hero
styles.usage: The card's number in the square format.

styles.name: card-x-name
styles.usage: Winner's first name (44px for ties).

styles.name: card-x-roast
styles.usage: The roast line.

styles.name: card-x-label
styles.usage: Award title; the hero's context line at 30px.

styles.name: card-x-meta
styles.usage: League name, GW and watermark.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Name to team line in a row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label; pill padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row gap between badge, text, sparkline and score; banner icon gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field padding; card-grid gutter; banner padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter at 390px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Start screen section gap.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between Market tab sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Share page section gap.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Side padding of every card; all padding on X cards.

tokens.name: card-safe-top
tokens.usage: Status cards: WhatsApp draws its name and progress here. Nothing important above it.

tokens.name: card-safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Status cards: WhatsApp's reply bar sits here. Keep the watermark above it.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Rank pills in lists.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: A selected segment (inside a 3px-padded track).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Segmented track, outline buttons, sheet option tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and text fields.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Banners; scaled card previews.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The pitch; the Wrapped card on the share page.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of the share sheet.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: The gradient panel on the Wrap card (1080 canvas).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills on cards, story rings, icon buttons.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target: icon buttons, quiet buttons, tab items.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of primary buttons and text fields.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a Market row (League rows 56px).

tokens.name: badge-size
tokens.usage: Team badge in Market rows (28px in tables, 128px on cards).

tokens.name: story-size
tokens.usage: Story circle, ring included.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Tab bar, home-indicator space included.

tokens.name: gradient-sky-light
tokens.usage: The Mist sky in light mode: deep teal through misty mint into white. Sits at the top of a screen or card (fsb-sky); content flows over it.

tokens.name: gradient-sky-dark
tokens.usage: The Mist sky in dark mode: deep teal with a soft mint glow, fading into bg.

tokens.name: gradient-mark
tokens.usage: The wordmark square: a tiny sky. Beside "Fantasy Squad Battle" and the card watermark.
